caption: A train pulls out of a station, and a suitcase standing loose in the aisle tips over toward the rear of the carriage.

sa.check: A suitcase stands loose in the aisle of a train carriage.
The train pulls out of the station.
The suitcase tips over toward the rear of the carriage.
The train moves first and the tip follows.

pc.expect: It begins to tip as the train starts, not before, and lies still once down.
pc.fail: It tips before the train moves; or tips with no motion; or rights itself and tips again.

pc.expect: It falls toward the back of the carriage.
pc.fail: It falls toward the front; or sideways; or up.

pc.expect: It falls to the floor and stays.
pc.fail: It hangs; or rights itself; or floats.

pc.expect: The case is rigid and thuds.
pc.fail: It folds; or bounces high; or melts.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The suitcase and the carriage stay the same.
pc.fail: The case changes colour; or the seats change; or the view outside jumps.
